title: Holy Mackerel
description: Perfect for slapping people with. Think fast, fisherman!
body:
Puts the fish into a newspaper, like the **holy mackerel from TF2**.
_Only applies when cooked._ It also:
- Renames Cooked Cod to Holy Cod
- Renames Cooked Salmon to Holy Salmon
- Waiting to be fixed: holy cod is for some reason ever so sligthly transparent. You probably wont notice unless you are actively looking for it.
